reviews.title: Nice low profile GPU!
reviews.comment: Good low-profile gpu for my small from factor budget build. Gets the job done in 1080p gaming. Bought used, but came in basically brand new condition with its clear stickers still on. Only had a somewhat damaged box. Over all decent gpu for the prices paid.
reviews.author: DY

reviews.title: Asus = quality??? Um sure
reviews.comment: Fan noise sounds abit grindy. I bet a fan will fail soon. Asus markets as a premium brand but I dunno if this is the card you want.
reviews.author: Greg G.
